newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney Casino sees profit for year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney Casino sees profit for year.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd said on Tuesday that it was trading on budget in the second quarter of the calendar year and expected to make a profit for the year.

"We are on budget," chairman Dick Warburton told reporters after the annual meeting after being asked how the June quarter was trading. "We expect to be in the black by the time the permanent casino opens (in December) - quite a bit in the black actually," he said.
"We are continuing the trend that we have shown in the first quarter," Warburton said.
Sydney casino earlier reported a net loss of A$600,000 for the three months to March 31 compared with a net profit of A$600,000 for the same period a year earlier.
At 12.20 p.m. (0205 GMT), Sydney Harbour Casino shares were one cent lower at A$2.18.
